requests.prompt: Create only the outer shell of a compact, stylized music sampler workstation. Warm handmade industrial design: sturdy boxy body with softened corners, matte workshop teal shell (#2F5C58), warm cream trim (#E8D8B7), and graphite lower feet (#2C3031). Broad masses, clean quiet surfaces, shallow control-deck recess only. No pads, screen, labels, knobs, switches, cables, hands, room, table, or extra props. One coherent shell with a flat stable underside and a bottom-center pivot. Target proportions 6:1.25:4; final Roblox stud scale will be set in DCC. Isolated single object.
